answer:
Fixed! The issue was in `src/invoice.js` line 11. The refactored commit inadvertently changed:

```javascript
var tax = calcTax(subtotal - discount, region);
```

to:

```javascript
const tax = computeTax(subtotal, region);
```

This caused the tax to be calculated on the full subtotal instead of on the amount after the discount is applied, making invoices with discount codes come out too high. I've restored the correct behavior and committed the fix. All 250 tests pass.
